description: The deuteron bar-even/bar-odd split is the H₆ partition-conjugation parity, derived and verified against the canonical derived caches. Two exact identities (30 dps): I1 weight conjugation-invariance w_λ=w_{λ'} (hook multiset preserved under transpose); I2 character conjugation = bar χ^{λ'}(β_D;q)=χ^λ(β_D;q⁻¹) (ratio 1.0 for all 11 partitions). Consequence: the per-block term obeys T_λ(q⁻¹)=(−1)^{n-1}T_{λ'}(q), so bar interchanges conjugate pairs and fixes the self-conjugate — 5 pairs + (3,2,1) for n=6. Key fact: (3,2,1) has a bar-even character (χ(q0)=χ(1/q0)=7.6256), so it feeds g₂ and never the bar-odd t (Lean barOdd_selfConj_zero). DERIVED: the parity structure; NOT derived: the Δ_λ magnitudes (Track-A gate) or the tr_M→binding normalization. scope-(a), audit-only, nothing wired; no fit.
tier: two exact categorical identities (30 dps, derived caches) + parity map + self-conjugate→bar-even; Lean-proved backbone; no fit

I1_weight_conjugation_invariance.reason: w_λ = (q−q⁻¹)^{n-1}/∏[hook]_q; conjugation transposes the diagram → permutes the hook multiset → ∏[hook]_q invariant.

I2_character_conjugation_is_bar.identity: χ^{λ'}(β_D; q) = χ^λ(β_D; q⁻¹) — partition conjugation IS the bar involution.

parity_map.meaning: bar maps the λ-block to ±the λ'-block: conjugate pairs interchange, self-conjugate sits on the diagonal — the concrete realisation of ConjugationParitySplit.lean's involution c.

key_fact_self_conjugate_bar_even.meaning: the self-conjugate (3,2,1) has a BAR-EVEN character (χ(q0)=χ(1/q0)); its Wedderburn contribution is purely bar-even — it feeds g₂, never the bar-odd t (Lean barOdd_selfConj_zero).

scope.derived: the PARITY structure of the deuteron correction = H₆ partition-conjugation parity (I1 + I2 + self-conjugate→bar-even; Lean backbone).
scope.not_derived: the Δ_λ per-partition magnitudes (Track-A gate) and the tr_M→binding normalization (β_D word / sign convention); the parity structure alone does not reproduce tr_M=0.3883 or C.
